s0201.literal: Prince Duolienie, garrisoning Yunnan Pindian, supplied the army from his own resources to help suppress bandits; an edict granted him bestowed court robes.
s0201.idiomatic: Prince Duolienie, garrisoning Yunnan Pindian, supplied the army from his own resources to help suppress bandits; an edict granted him bestowed court robes.

s0202.literal: On bingchen day the great traveling tent used by Taizu was repaired.
s0202.idiomatic: On bingchen day the great traveling tent used by Taizu was repaired.

s0203.literal: On wuwu day the Xuanyuan Abbey of Jiqing Route was made the Great Yuan Prospering Longevity Palace.
s0203.idiomatic: On wuwu day the Xuanyuan Abbey of Jiqing Route was made the Great Yuan Prospering Longevity Palace.

s0204.literal: Xinghe was ordered to build dwellings for sea hawks; Shangdu was ordered to build dwellings for falcons.
s0204.idiomatic: Xinghe was ordered to build dwellings for sea hawks; Shangdu was ordered to build dwellings for falcons.

s0205.literal: On gengshen day the Henan Confucian Wu Bing was specially appointed registrar of the Arts and Literature Directorate, still granted matching rank.
s0205.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Henan Confucian Wu Bing was specially appointed registrar of the Arts and Literature Directorate, still granted matching rank.

s0206.literal: In Jing County of Ningguo Route, Zhang Dao killed a man and became a bandit; his younger brother Ji joined but did not share in the deed, and while in custody the case went undecided for seven years.
s0206.idiomatic: In Jing County of Ningguo Route, Zhang Dao killed a man and became a bandit; his younger brother Ji joined but did not share in the deed, and while in custody the case went undecided for 7 years.

s0207.literal: Ji's mother was elderly with no other sons or grandsons; central secretariat officials reported it; an edict spared him death, flogged and dismissed him, and ordered him to support his mother.
s0207.idiomatic: Ji's mother was elderly with no other sons or grandsons; central secretariat officials reported it; an edict spared him death, flogged and dismissed him, and ordered him to support his mother.

s0208.literal: On xinwei day five thousand ingots of Shandong salt duty notes relieved famine among nine thousand households in Boxing Prefecture, and one thousand ingots relieved salt workers at Xinyang and other stations.
s0208.idiomatic: On xinwei day 5,000 ingots of Shandong salt duty notes relieved famine among 9,000 households in Boxing Prefecture, and 1,000 ingots relieved salt workers at Xinyang and other stations.

s0209.literal: Censorate officials said: "Palace Stores commissioner Hasaer Buhua, while attending the Emperor at his hidden residence, received seventy-nine horses and also embezzled government storehouse goods.
s0209.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Palace Stores commissioner Hasaer Buhua, while attending the Emperor at his hidden residence, received 79 horses and also embezzled government storehouse goods.

s0210.literal: At the beginning of Tiansli, leading troops at Lugou Bridge, he fled upon meeting the enemy, arbitrarily closed the city gate, and alarmed the people.
s0210.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tiansli, leading troops at Lugou Bridge, he fled upon meeting the enemy, arbitrarily closed the city gate, and alarmed the people.

s0211.literal: Revenue commissioner Nahaqu once concealed government horses, also forged additions to imperial commands, and also received from Prince Woji one jeweled belt and one hundred sixty ingots of notes.
s0211.idiomatic: Revenue commissioner Nahaqu once concealed government horses, also forged additions to imperial commands, and also received from Prince Woji 1 jeweled belt and 160 ingots of notes.

s0212.literal: We deliberated and find their crimes warrant one hundred seven strokes, dismissal from name, and expulsion to their home districts.
s0212.idiomatic: We deliberated and find their crimes warrant 107 strokes, dismissal from name, and expulsion to their home districts.

s0214.literal: On renxu day privy council officials said: "The Yunnan affair is settled. Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince Suosi Ban reports that among Mongol troops and Kharchang, Luoluo, and other rebellious peoples, some were executed and some surrendered; although broadly pacified, the remainder fled into mountain valleys and one cannot be certain they will not turn again — we now request that Prince of Jing Yisubughan and Princes Suonan and others each lead their departments to garrison for one or two years to display awe.
s0214.idiomatic: On renxu day privy council officials said: "The Yunnan affair is settled. Pacifier of the West Martial and Tranquil Prince Suosi Ban reports that among Mongol troops and Kharchang, Luoluo, and other rebellious peoples, some were executed and some surrendered; although broadly pacified, the remainder fled into mountain valleys and one cannot be certain they will not turn again — we now request that Prince of Jing Yisubughan and Princes Suonan and others each lead their departments to garrison for 1 or 2 years to display awe.

s0216.literal: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri was still ordered to divide troops, assigning three hundred temüch and three hundred qichibo to garrison together for one year to pacify and settle the region; the remaining armies were all sent back to their departments, and the commanding officers were summoned to court.
s0216.idiomatic: Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri was still ordered to divide troops, assigning 300 temüch and 300 qichibo to garrison together for 1 year to pacify and settle the region; the remaining armies were all sent back to their departments, and the commanding officers were summoned to court.

s0217.literal: Tanma Chi had already been appointed Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor; he was then ordered to oversee military affairs within the borders.
s0217.idiomatic: Tanma Chi had already been appointed Yunnan Branch Secretariat grand councillor; he was then ordered to oversee military affairs within the borders.

s0218.literal: Lucheng County in Lu Prefecture suffered great flood.
s0218.idiomatic: Lucheng County in Lu Prefecture suffered great flood.

s0219.literal: On guihai day more than two hundred eighty Mongol households under Prince Wanzhe Buqan reported famine; Hedong Pacification Commission was ordered to distribute government grain for relief.
s0219.idiomatic: On guihai day more than 280 Mongol households under Prince Wanzhe Buqan reported famine; Hedong Pacification Commission was ordered to distribute government grain for relief.

s0220.literal: On jiazi day Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported that the colony fields at Zhongnan had last year suffered great flood, damaging more than forty qing of grain — an edict exempted their rent.
s0220.idiomatic: On jiazi day Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported that the colony fields at Zhongnan had last year suffered great flood, damaging more than 40 qing of grain — an edict exempted their rent.

s0221.literal: Two hundred households of Prince Zhenning Na Hai's retinue, livestock damaged by wind and snow — Lingbei Branch Secretariat was ordered to grant two months' relief grain.
s0221.idiomatic: Two hundred households of Prince Zhenning Na Hai's retinue, livestock damaged by wind and snow — Lingbei Branch Secretariat was ordered to grant 2 months' relief grain.

s0222.literal: The Qipchaq Office presented a famous garden; the Censorate was ordered to pay one thousand ingots of forfeiture notes as its price.
s0222.idiomatic: The Qipchaq Office presented a famous garden; the Censorate was ordered to pay 1,000 ingots of forfeiture notes as its price.

s0223.literal: Prince Qiba said: "Each year when I follow the seasonal tour the expense is very great. My elder brother Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and younger brother Yishiban each year receive five hundred ingots of notes and five thousand bolts of silks and cloth.
s0223.idiomatic: Prince Qiba said: "Each year when I follow the seasonal tour the expense is very great. My elder brother Prince of Yu Alaqtenashiri and younger brother Yishiban each year receive 500 ingots of notes and 5,000 bolts of silks and cloth.

s0224.literal: I venture to look to their example in requesting the same."
s0224.idiomatic: I venture to look to their example in requesting the same."

s0226.literal: An edict: "Former Ministry of Revenue chancellor Toqto'a may follow the Sanbaonu precedent — return the confiscated family wealth to his family."
s0226.idiomatic: An edict: "Former Ministry of Revenue chancellor Toqto'a may follow the Sanbaonu precedent — return the confiscated family wealth to his family."

s0227.literal: Censorate officials said: "Associate administrator of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Yin Zhongrong is lecherous, greedy, and fawning, falsely mourning yet holding office."
s0227.idiomatic: Censorate officials said: "Associate administrator of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Yin Zhongrong is lecherous, greedy, and fawning, falsely mourning yet holding office."

s0229.literal: More than thirteen thousand famine households in Taixing County of Yang Prefecture — Henan Branch Secretariat had first relieved them with one month's grain and then reported; this was approved.
s0229.idiomatic: More than 13,000 famine households in Taixing County of Yang Prefecture — Henan Branch Secretariat had first relieved them with 1 month's grain and then reported; this was approved.

s0230.literal: Liaodong Branch Secretariat was ordered to distribute grain to relieve famine among Mongol people within the Boluo tribes.
s0230.idiomatic: Liaodong Branch Secretariat was ordered to distribute grain to relieve famine among Mongol people within the Boluo tribes.

s0231.literal: On wuchen day, for compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》, the Kuizhang Pavilion requested from the Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy the book 《Tuoba Chiyan》 to record affairs from Taizu onward; accordingly Hanlin academician expositor Babuqa and Tashiyiya were ordered.
s0231.idiomatic: On wuchen day, for compiling the 《Jingshi Dadian》, the Kuizhang Pavilion requested from the Hanlin Imperial Historical Records Academy the book 《Tuoba Chiyan》 to record affairs from Taizu onward; accordingly Hanlin academician expositor Babuqa and Tashiyiya were ordered.

s0232.literal: Babuqa said: "The 《Tuoba Chiyan》 concerns secret prohibitions and may not be copied by outsiders; we dare not obey the edict."
s0232.idiomatic: Babuqa said: "The 《Tuoba Chiyan》 concerns secret prohibitions and may not be copied by outsiders; we dare not obey the edict."

s0234.literal: Arch Guard Office ceremonial guards were additionally established.
s0234.idiomatic: Arch Guard Office ceremonial guards were additionally established.

s0235.literal: Armory Temple artisan officials were ordered to avoid Yuan registry.
s0235.idiomatic: Armory Temple artisan officials were ordered to avoid Yuan registry.

s0236.literal: Envoys were dispatched to summon Zhao Shiyan at Jiqing.
s0236.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to summon Zhao Shiyan at Jiqing.

s0237.literal: An edict ordered one thousand sets of the 《Immeasurable Life Sutra》 written in gold ink in Uighur script.
s0237.idiomatic: An edict ordered 1,000 sets of the 《Immeasurable Life Sutra》 written in gold ink in Uighur script.

s0238.literal: On renshen day six hundred newly registered soldiers of the Xuanzhong Loyal Guard were dispersed to their home districts, with a deadline of the first day of the seventh month to return to camp.
s0238.idiomatic: On renshen day 600 newly registered soldiers of the Xuanzhong Loyal Guard were dispersed to their home districts, with a deadline of the 1st day of the 7th month to return to camp.

s0239.literal: Subordinate counties of Heng Prefecture had drought and locusts several years running, again great flood; the people had nearly consumed all plants and trees, and moreover pestilence — nineteen in ten died; Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission requested ten thousand shi of relief grain; it was approved.
s0239.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Heng Prefecture had drought and locusts several years running, again great flood; the people had nearly consumed all plants and trees, and moreover pestilence — 19 in 10 died; Hunan Circuit Pacification Commission requested 10,000 shi of relief grain; it was approved.

s0240.literal: Hezhong Prefecture had locusts; subordinate counties of Jinning, Jining, Datong, and Hejian routes all reported famine from drought preventing planting.
s0240.idiomatic: Hezhong Prefecture had locusts; subordinate counties of Jinning, Jining, Datong, and Hejian routes all reported famine from drought preventing planting.

s0241.literal: Huduodijin, wife of Arsalan Minggu in Ganzhou, was awarded a gate plaque for chastity.
s0241.idiomatic: Huduodijin, wife of Arsalan Minggu in Ganzhou, was awarded a gate plaque for chastity.

s0242.literal: Fifth month, bingzi day, the crown prince's shadow hall made sacrificial vessels following the precedent of Emperor Yuzong.
s0242.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingzi day, the crown prince's shadow hall made sacrificial vessels following the precedent of Emperor Yuzong.

s0243.literal: An edict ordered construction of the palace attendant chief directorate public offices.
s0243.idiomatic: An edict ordered construction of the palace attendant chief directorate public offices.

s0244.literal: On dingchou day Mars infringed the left horn of the Xuanyuan constellation.
s0244.idiomatic: On dingchou day Mars infringed the left horn of the Xuanyuan constellation.

s0245.literal: The palace attendant chief directorate was granted relay-seal edicts.
s0245.idiomatic: The palace attendant chief directorate was granted relay-seal edicts.

s0246.literal: Guard troops were mobilized to dredge the Jinshui River.
s0246.idiomatic: Guard troops were mobilized to dredge the Jinshui River.

s0247.literal: On jimao day Annam heir Chen Rifu sent his minister Duan Zijhen to court with tribute.
s0247.idiomatic: On jimao day Annam heir Chen Rifu sent his minister Duan Zijhen to court with tribute.

s0248.literal: Wangjiang County of Anqing and Shanyang County of Huai'an had last year all suffered flood — their field rent was exempted.
s0248.idiomatic: Wangjiang County of Anqing and Shanyang County of Huai'an had last year all suffered flood — their field rent was exempted.

s0249.literal: On bingxu day Grand Imperial Blessings Court officials said: "The twelve temples such as Great Ten Thousand Peace built by successive reigns had an original quota of three thousand one hundred fifty monks with annual grain grants; now their number has grown excessively — we request removing nine hundred forty-three."
s0249.idiomatic: On bingxu day Grand Imperial Blessings Court officials said: "The 12 temples such as Great Ten Thousand Peace built by successive reigns had an original quota of 3,150 monks with annual grain grants; now their number has grown excessively — we request removing 943."

s0251.literal: Taoyuan Prefecture of Changde had last year flood disaster — rent was exempted.
s0251.idiomatic: Taoyuan Prefecture of Changde had last year flood disaster — rent was exempted.

s0252.literal: On dinghai day the qalan household intake office was re-established, still subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.
s0252.idiomatic: On dinghai day the qalan household intake office was re-established, still subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.

s0253.literal: The Privy Council was ordered to mobilize troops to repair the capital city.
s0253.idiomatic: The Privy Council was ordered to mobilize troops to repair the capital city.

s0254.literal: On jichou day pacification commissions and commander-in-chief's offices were established at Yunbai and other places; local official Zhaolian was made pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.
s0254.idiomatic: On jichou day pacification commissions and commander-in-chief's offices were established at Yunbai and other places; local official Zhaolian was made pacification commissioner and commander-in-chief.

s0255.literal: Also established Yunnan Lin'an and Yuanjiang Pacification Commission jointly overseeing the ten-thousand-household military office.
s0255.idiomatic: Also established Yunnan Lin'an and Yuanjiang Pacification Commission jointly overseeing the ten-thousand-household military office.

s0256.literal: Mengding and Mengjing routes were both made military-civilian chief directorates, rank 3b.
s0256.idiomatic: Mengding and Mengjing routes were both made military-civilian chief directorates, rank 3b.

s0257.literal: Zhexian, Mengqing, Yinshaluo and other districts were all made military-civilian prefectures, rank 3c.
s0257.idiomatic: Zhexian, Mengqing, Yinshaluo and other districts were all made military-civilian prefectures, rank 3c.

s0258.literal: Mengbing, Mengguang, Zheyang and other districts all had military-civilian chief magistrates established, rank 4a.
s0258.idiomatic: Mengbing, Mengguang, Zheyang and other districts all had military-civilian chief magistrates established, rank 4a.

s0259.literal: Song Derang and Zhao Ren of Yidu Route each contributed three hundred shi of rice to relieve nine thousand famine households in Jiao Prefecture; central secretariat officials requested official posts per the grain-contribution precedent; it was approved.
s0259.idiomatic: Song Derang and Zhao Ren of Yidu Route each contributed 300 shi of rice to relieve 9,000 famine households in Jiao Prefecture; central secretariat officials requested official posts per the grain-contribution precedent; it was approved.

s0260.literal: Winter-garrison guard households of twenty-one thousand five hundred were granted four months' grain.
s0260.idiomatic: Winter-garrison guard households of 21,500 were granted 4 months' grain.

s0261.literal: On gengyin day Yunnan Province Luchuan Route Military-Civilian Chief Directorate was established, with local officials in charge; appointees at each rank were given gold tallies.
s0261.idiomatic: On gengyin day Yunnan Province Luchuan Route Military-Civilian Chief Directorate was established, with local officials in charge; appointees at each rank were given gold tallies.

s0262.literal: On guisi day Puman Mengwu of Weichu Route in Yunnan came to court with tribute, wishing to pay silver as annual tribute — an edict established one subprefecture and thirty-three local official posts, all granted gold and silver tallies.
s0262.idiomatic: On guisi day Puman Mengwu of Weichu Route in Yunnan came to court with tribute, wishing to pay silver as annual tribute — an edict established 1 subprefecture and 33 local official posts, all granted gold and silver tallies.

s0263.literal: On jiawu day Venus infringed the Net mansion.
s0263.idiomatic: On jiawu day Venus infringed the Net mansion.

s0264.literal: Pacification commissioner Tuoyin was enfeoffed Prince of Ji.
s0264.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner Tuoyin was enfeoffed Prince of Ji.

s0265.literal: Five hundred qing of Pingjiang government fields were used to establish a rice-field intake office, subordinate to the palace attendant chief directorate.
s0265.idiomatic: 500 qing of Pingjiang government fields were used to establish a rice-field intake office, subordinate to the palace attendant chief directorate.

s0266.literal: On yiwei day Shaanxi Branch Censor-in-Chief Tobetai was made privy council administrator.
s0266.idiomatic: On yiwei day Shaanxi Branch Censor-in-Chief Tobetai was made privy council administrator.

s0267.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yuelu Buhua repeatedly resigned; Jiangxi Branch Secretariat grand councillor Duorji resigned the new appointment for illness — all were granted.
s0267.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Yuelu Buhua repeatedly resigned; Jiangxi Branch Secretariat grand councillor Duorji resigned the new appointment for illness — all were granted.

s0268.literal: Lady Toghusi's wife succeeded in administering Prince Mingzong's tent palace; an edict granted forty thousand households in Xiangtan Prefecture as fief maintenance.
s0268.idiomatic: Lady Toghusi's wife succeeded in administering Prince Mingzong's tent palace; an edict granted 40,000 households in Xiangtan Prefecture as fief maintenance.

s0269.literal: The Kuizhang Pavilion academician office completed compiling the 《Imperial Dynasty Jingshi Dadian》.
s0269.idiomatic: The Kuizhang Pavilion academician office completed compiling the 《Imperial Dynasty Jingshi Dadian》.

s0270.literal: An edict ordered one canon of Buddhist scriptures written in gold ink.
s0270.idiomatic: An edict ordered 1 canon of Buddhist scriptures written in gold ink.

s0271.literal: On bingshen day the imperial procession departed for Shangdu.
s0271.idiomatic: On bingshen day the imperial procession departed for Shangdu.

s0272.literal: Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Wang Shouchang resigned office; not granted.
s0272.idiomatic: Sichuan Branch Secretariat grand councillor Wang Shouchang resigned office; not granted.

s0273.literal: An edict that all capital offices daily assemble at public quarters, from morning until evening not neglecting affairs.
s0273.idiomatic: An edict that all capital offices daily assemble at public quarters, from morning until evening not neglecting affairs.

s0274.literal: Luanyang, Huanzhou, Liling Terrace, Xibaochi, and Shiba'ertu — five relay stations — were each relieved with two hundred ingots of notes.
s0274.idiomatic: Luanyang, Huanzhou, Liling Terrace, Xibaochi, and Shiba'ertu — 5 relay stations — were each relieved with 200 ingots of notes.

s0275.literal: Huanzhou people presented wheat they had planted; an edict granted two bolts of silks and cloth and sent them away with consolation.
s0275.idiomatic: Huanzhou people presented wheat they had planted; an edict granted 2 bolts of silks and cloth and sent them away with consolation.

s0276.literal: On wuxu day halted at Hong Bridge; personally inspected the living shrine to El Temür.
s0276.idiomatic: On wuxu day halted at Hong Bridge; personally inspected the living shrine to El Temür.

s0277.literal: The Zhao Xiao camp-maintenance office subordinate to the Grand Imperial Blessings Court was placed under the Chongxi Chief Directorate.
s0277.idiomatic: The Zhao Xiao camp-maintenance office subordinate to the Grand Imperial Blessings Court was placed under the Chongxi Chief Directorate.

s0278.literal: Three thousand five hundred famine households of the Eastern Route Mongol ten-thousand-household office in Liaodong were granted two months' grain.
s0278.idiomatic: 3,500 famine households of the Eastern Route Mongol ten-thousand-household office in Liaodong were granted 2 months' grain.

s0279.literal: On jihai day Ye'erjini administered privy council affairs.
s0279.idiomatic: On jihai day Ye'erjini administered privy council affairs.

s0280.literal: Eight Fan western barbarian official Amalu presented local products in tribute.
s0280.idiomatic: Eight Fan western barbarian official Amalu presented local products in tribute.

s0281.literal: Gaoyou, Baoying and other counties had last year flood — rent was exempted.
s0281.idiomatic: Gaoyou, Baoying and other counties had last year flood — rent was exempted.

s0282.literal: On gengzi day the moon infringed Venus.
s0282.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon infringed Venus.

s0283.literal: On xinchou day Venus crossed the sky at midday.
s0283.idiomatic: On xinchou day Venus crossed the sky at midday.

s0284.literal: The Alan ten-thousand-household office was changed to the Martial Resolute ten-thousand-household office, granted a silver seal, and Bayan was ordered to command it.
s0284.idiomatic: The Alan ten-thousand-household office was changed to the Martial Resolute ten-thousand-household office, granted a silver seal, and Bayan was ordered to command it.

s0285.literal: The chaste integrity of Ma Wan's wife Jin of Zhangqiu County, Jinan, was commemorated with a gate plaque.
s0285.idiomatic: The chaste integrity of Ma Wan's wife Jin of Zhangqiu County, Jinan, was commemorated with a gate plaque.

s0286.literal: On guimao day Ye'erjini was advanced to Grand Mentor and granted a silver seal.
s0286.idiomatic: On guimao day Ye'erjini was advanced to Grand Mentor and granted a silver seal.

s0287.literal: Four thousand ingots of Hejian salt duty notes relieved four thousand one hundred famine households in Hejian subordinate counties.
s0287.idiomatic: 4,000 ingots of Hejian salt duty notes relieved 4,100 famine households in Hejian subordinate counties.

s0288.literal: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Bureau of Transmission to rectify internal and external land and water relays.
s0288.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered the Bureau of Transmission to rectify internal and external land and water relays.

s0289.literal: Xuanzheng Court officials said: "By old regulation, Buddhist services at the successive emperors' spirit halls and various temples totaled two hundred sixteen per year; now sixteen are reduced as the fixed form."
s0289.idiomatic: Xuanzheng Court officials said: "By old regulation, Buddhist services at the successive emperors' spirit halls and various temples totaled 216 per year; now 16 are reduced as the fixed form."

s0291.literal: Dongchang and Baoding routes, Pu and Tang prefectures — silkworms were eating mulberry.
s0291.idiomatic: Dongchang and Baoding routes, Pu and Tang prefectures — silkworms were eating mulberry.

s0292.literal: Subordinate counties of Ningxia, Shaoqing, Baoding, Dean, and Hejian routes suffered great flood.
s0292.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Ningxia, Shaoqing, Baoding, Dean, and Hejian routes suffered great flood.

s0293.literal: Sixth month, yisi day first of month, thirty thousand ingots from the Palace Stores Court were levied for the empress's travel expenses.
s0293.idiomatic: Sixth month, yisi day first of month, 30,000 ingots from the Palace Stores Court were levied for the empress's travel expenses.

s0294.literal: An edict ordered Henan Branch Secretariat to erect a monument to Abuhaiya's governance.
s0294.idiomatic: An edict ordered Henan Branch Secretariat to erect a monument to Abuhaiya's governance.

s0295.literal: Investigating censor Han Yuanshan said: "National universities of successive dynasties all flourished; only our dynasty's national university students number barely four hundred, and moreover quotas are divided among Mongol, semuren, and Han.
s0295.idiomatic: Investigating censor Han Yuanshan said: "National universities of successive dynasties all flourished; only our dynasty's national university students number barely 400, and moreover quotas are divided among Mongol, semuren, and Han.

s0296.literal: We request that Mongol, semuren, and Han — without limiting quotas — all be permitted to enter study."
s0296.idiomatic: We request that Mongol, semuren, and Han — without limiting quotas — all be permitted to enter study."

s0297.literal: Investigating censor Chen Shouzhong also said: "We request that officials whose parents are elderly and who have no other attendant son to support them, without limiting place or rank, should preferably be transferred nearby with favor — thereby broadly extending the way of loyalty and filial piety."
s0297.idiomatic: Investigating censor Chen Shouzhong also said: "We request that officials whose parents are elderly and who have no other attendant son to support them, without limiting place or rank, should preferably be transferred nearby with favor — thereby broadly extending the way of loyalty and filial piety."

s0299.literal: Five thousand shi of grain was distributed to relieve famine among subordinate counties of Xinghe.
s0299.idiomatic: 5,000 shi of grain was distributed to relieve famine among subordinate counties of Xinghe.

s0300.literal: On dingwei day Venus was seen in daytime.
s0300.idiomatic: On dingwei day Venus was seen in daytime.
